reason: The price is nothing for a business my size, but this is built for someone WhatsApping an Excel file. I need order confirmations firing automatically from my website, POS and WooCommerce, and nothing here says it connects to any of that.
objection: No mention of an API or WooCommerce/POS plugin, so it becomes another manual tool my staff have to remember to use, and for sale blasts my customers already read WhatsApp for free.
would_change_my_mind: A working WooCommerce plugin or API that sends order confirmations from my site and POS automatically, which I can test with the 10 free SMS.
